module_summary: Triangle wave generator: a 2-state up/down FSM increments or decrements a 5-bit wave register between 0 and 31.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Direction FSM: state 0 counts wave up, state 1 counts down; flips at 31 and 0.

anchors.name: wave
anchors.why: 5-bit up/down counter output forming the triangle waveform; its extremes trigger state changes.

groups.name: Direction controller
groups.description: Up/down direction state machine switching at wave extremes 31 and 0.

groups.name: Wave counter
groups.description: 5-bit up/down counter producing the triangle wave output.
